GeoClient

Source: R/GeoClient.R
GeoClient.Rd

R6 class for downloading, processing, and caching Portuguese geographic boundaries from CAOP (Carta Administrativa Oficial de Portugal), and for filtered queries to DGT's OGC API. get_censos() and get_map() use one for their downloads too.

Failed downloads

When a download fails, because a server can't be reached or a file has moved or changed, the method stops with an error saying which and why. The error has class geopt_download_error, so a script can catch download failures alone with tryCatch(..., geopt_download_error = ...).

Usage

client <- GeoClient$new()
sf <- client$get_caop("continente", "municipio")

Active bindings

cache_dir

Character. Path to the cache directory. Defaults to tools::R_user_dir("geopt", "cache").

use_cache

Logical. Whether to read and write cached results (default TRUE). With FALSE, cached results are neither read nor written: each call builds its result again, and the latest CAOP year is looked up online instead of taken from the cache. Downloaded files (CAOP and census GeoPackages) are kept and reused either way; $clear_cache("raw") removes them.

crs

Integer EPSG code for the default coordinate reference system. Defaults to 4326 (WGS84). Output can be transformed to any CRS via the crs argument of $get_caop().

GeoClient$get_caop()

Get geographic boundaries as an sf object.

Usage

GeoClient$get_caop(region, level, year = NULL, crs = NULL, detail = "full")

Arguments

region

One of "continente", "raa", "ram".

level

One of "freguesia", "municipio", "distrito", "nuts1", "nuts2", "nuts3".

year

CAOP year. If NULL, resolves to the latest available.

crs

Output EPSG code. If NULL, uses the client default.

detail

Simplification level: "full", "high", "medium", "low" or "very_low".

Returns

An sf object.

GeoClient$get_ogc()

Get features from a DGT OGC API collection.

Queries https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/ and returns the response as an sf object. Use this for filtered or bounded subsets (single municipio, bbox around a city, COS land-cover by area). For bulk country-wide downloads of CAOP, $get_caop() is faster.

Usage

GeoClient$get_ogc(
  collection,
  bbox = NULL,
  bbox_crs = 4326L,
  properties = NULL,
  cql_filter = NULL,
  crs = NULL,
  limit = OGC_DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  max_features = Inf
)

Arguments

collection

Collection id, e.g. "freguesias", "municipios", "nuts3", "cos2023v1". See $list_ogc_collections(); an id geopt doesn't know is an error that lists the ones it does. The large collections ("cos2018v3", "cos2023v1", "cadastro") need a bbox, properties or cql_filter.

bbox

Numeric length-4 vector c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) or an sf bbox object. If NULL, no spatial filter is applied.

bbox_crs

Integer EPSG code that bbox is expressed in. Defaults to 4326. Only sent to the server when not 4326.

properties

Named list of equality filters on attribute columns, e.g. list(distrito = "Lisboa"). Use cql_filter for more complex predicates.

cql_filter

Optional CQL-Text filter string, passed through verbatim. Example: "distrito_ilha = 'Lisboa'". DGT's server accepts CQL1 syntax (cql-text), not CQL2.

crs

Output EPSG code. If NULL, uses the client default. Requested server-side to avoid client-side reprojection.

limit

Page size sent to the server. Default 1000.

max_features

Stop pagination after this many features. Defaults to Inf (fetch everything).

Returns

An sf object, or NULL if the query returned zero features.

GeoClient$list_ogc_collections()

List collections reported live by the DGT OGC API.

Hits /collections?f=json. Used for discovery; the package itself validates against the hardcoded OGC_COLLECTIONS registry.

Usage

GeoClient$list_ogc_collections()

Returns

A data.frame with columns id, title, item_type, description.

GeoClient$export_boundaries()

Export boundaries to a file format suitable for dashboards.

Usage

  sf_obj,

  detail = NULL,
  crs = 4326L
)

Arguments

sf_obj

An sf object.

path

Output file path.

format

Output format: "geojson" or "gpkg".

detail

Optional simplification level before export.

crs

Output EPSG code. Defaults to 4326 (WGS84) for web compatibility.

Returns

The output path (invisibly).
